product: Lakeflow pipelines system tables are now generally available (GA)
tagline: The lakeflow system tables pipelines and pipeline update timeline are now generally available.
what_it_does: The lakeflow system tables pipelines and pipeline update timeline are now generally available. These tables record the pipelines and pipeline updates in your account. For a reference of these tables, see Jobs system table reference.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: The lakeflow system tables pipelines and pipeline update timeline are now generally available. These tables record the pipelines and pipeline updates in your account.

capabilities.title: Be both a metastore admin
capabilities.desc: Be both a metastore admin and an account admin, or

capabilities.title: Have USE and SELECT permissions
capabilities.desc: Have USE and SELECT permissions on the system schemas. See Grant access to system tables.

key_takeaway: The lakeflow system tables pipelines and pipeline update timeline are now generally available.
